build_autoencoder_model: build a volumetric autoencoder with identity encoder, expression encoder, bottleneck, decoder assembler, and raymarcher submodules
run_autoencoder_forward: run the autoencoder forward pass with camera parameters, mesh vertices, texture maps, and pixel coordinates to reconstruct images
run_autoencoder_decode: run the autoencoder decode method with identity conditioning, expression encoding, and camera parameters to render via ray marching
review_autoencoder_forward: review the Autoencoder forward method which encodes identity and expression then decodes and renders using ray marching
review_autoencoder_decode: review the Autoencoder decode method which assembles decoder output, ray marches, applies color correction, and composites background
